Since I played my first PBF game I've been wanting to try my hand at running a game. It just so happens that challenge mode came out at pretty much the same time. So I'd like to run a high stakes game not for the faint of heart where you get settings as hard as they come without houserules. That means advanced challenge mode with pure randomizer.

Get your chance to win the first PBF challenge game on this forum and a place in a Hall of Fame Topic. If the response is good I'll run a few of these.

Sky-Scraper (grysqrl)

The Scholar (skylarfried13)

The Eternal Haka (RanisTheSlayer)

Kvothe Six-Strings (Ario)

Guise (Powerhound_2000)

Villain:

Infinitor (Advanced Challenge)

Environment:

Realm of Discord

posts.cooked:
Sanity in Peril - ROUND 1 - Rude Awakening

Villain Turn (Infinitor - Tormented Malefactor)
 

Setup - The 4 initial manifestations revealed were in order: Twisted Miscreation(A)[4], Recalescent Hellion(A)[4], Lambent Reaper(A)[4]and Twisted Miscreation(B)[4]

Start -
  Less than 5 manifestations (4) in play does not flip

Play - Lambent Reaper(B)

End - (see comment section for the damage decision tree)
 - Infinitor deals Sky-Scraper [29] 4 Energy damage
 - Infinitor plays cards until 6 (H+1) Manifestations are in Play (Only 5 Manifestations are out)
      - Infinitor plays Insanity: Play the top card of the villain deck if that card is a Manifestation card Repeat the entire game text of this card

- Insanity Plays Crushing Cage [4] then Plays Crazed Artifice because Crushing Cage was a Manifestation

- Crazed Artifice reveals 5 cards: Lambent Reaper, Recalescent Hellion, Whispers of Oblivion, Ocular Swarm, Recalescent Hellion all are put in play exept Whispers of Oblivion (Manifestations were put in play by Crazed Artifice)

- Twisted Miscreation(A)[4] deals Haka [28] 5 Energy damage

-  Recalescent Hellion(A)[4] deals Sky-Scraper [26] and Scholar [26] 3 Fire damage each

-  Lambent Reaper(A)[4] deals Kvothe [19] 2 Energy damage and 2 Psychic damage

- Twisted Miscreation(B)[4] deals Haka [23] 5 Energy damage

-  Lambent Reaper(B)[4] deals Kvothe [15] 2 Energy damage and 2 Psychic damage

-  Lambent Reaper(C)[4] deals Kvothe [11] 2 Energy damage and 2 Psychic damage

-  Recalescent Hellion(B)[4] deals Sky-Scraper [23] and Guise [24] 3 Fire damage each

-  Recalescent Hellion(A)[4] deals Scholar [23] and Guise [21] 3 Fire damage each

=======
Effects:

- Reduce damage dealt to Manifestation cards by 2 (Challenge Mode)

- At the start of the Villain turn if there are 5 or more Manifestations Cards in play Flip Infinitors Villain Character Cards (Infinitor)

- Reduce damage dealt to villain targets by 1 (Infinitor)

- At the end of the villain turn Infinitor deals the Hero Target with the Highest HP 4 Energy damage (Infinitor)

- At the end of the Villain Turn, Play cards from the top of the villain deck until at least 6 Manifestation cards are in play (Infinitor Advanced)

- Whenever Twisted Miscreation would be dealt damage reduce that damage to 1 (Twisted Miscreation A,B and C)

- At the End of the Villain Turn, Twisted Miscreation deals the Hero Target with the Highest HP 5 Energy damage (Twisted Miscreation A,B and C)

- At the End of the Villain Turn, Recalescent Hellion deals the two Hero Targets with the Highest HP 3 Fire damage each (Recalescent Hellion A,B and C)

- At the End of the Villain Turn, Lambent Reaper deals the Hero Target with the Lowest HP 2 Energy damage and 2 Psychic damage (Lambent Reaper A,B and C)

- Sky-Scraper (volunteered) may not play cards. At the start of that heros turn, this card deals that hero then itself 1Psychic and 1 Energy damage (Crushing Cage)

- Whenever this card or any other manifestation card is destroyed reveal the top card of the villain deck. If the revealed card is a Manifestation put it in play. If not, discard it and this card deals each hero target 1 energy damage (Ocular Swarm)

 

Status
======
Infinitor  [65] (Tormented Malefactor)(-1)

Twisted Miscreation(A)[4] (-3)

Recalescent Hellion(A)[4] (-3)

Lambent Reaper(A)[4] (-3)

Twisted Miscreation(B)[4] (-3)

Lambent Reaper(B)[4] (-3)

Crushing Cage [4] (-3)

Lambent Reaper(C)[4] (-3)

Recalescent Hellion(B)[4] (-3)

Ocular Swarm [4] (-3)

Recalescent Hellion(C)[4] (-3)

 

Villain Trash: Whispers of Oblivion, Crazed Artifice and Insanity

------- 
Sky-Scraper            [23] (Tied high HP)
Scholar                   [23] (Tied high HP)
Eternal Haka           [23] (Tied high HP)
Kvothe Six-Strings  [11] (low HP)
Guise                      [21]

------- Environment --------
None

Comments:

All damage choices ultimately led to those HP values so I didn't bother asking you guys. You still need to decide wich hero is affected by the crushing cage. That was a nasty first turn I didn't expect to have 10 manifestations in play before heroes could act. I tried to be as concise as I could with effects if something isn't clear tell me and I'll rectify it.
